scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: When Kate is away, the phone rings at every desk.
scene.zh: Kate 不在的時候，每個人桌上的電話都會響。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: So we answer it ourselves. Most calls are from customers.
scene.zh: 所以我們都自己接。大部分是客人打來的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There it goes. Go ahead, you take this one.
scene.zh: 響了。來，這通你接。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hello, thank you for calling Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: Harbor Trading 您好，感謝您的來電。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Nice and friendly. So, who is it?
scene.zh: 很好，很親切。那是誰打來的？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: There's somebody on the phone for you.
scene.zh: 有人打電話找你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: For me? It's probably the man from the lamp shop.
scene.zh: 找我？大概是燈具店那位先生。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Stay and listen to this conversation. You'll learn a lot.
scene.zh: 你留下來聽我講這通，會學到很多。

fills.en: Please don't ___ up. I'll transfer you now.
fills.zh: 請先不要掛斷，我現在幫您轉接。

fills.note: I'll = I will，後面接動詞原形。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello, this is James Hughes, calling from England.
scene.zh: 您好，我是 James Hughes，從英國打來的。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I can't reach Ms. Carter on her direct line. Could you put me through?
scene.zh: 我打 Carter 小姐的直撥電話一直找不到她。可以幫我轉過去嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: One moment, please, I'll transfer you.
scene.zh: 請稍等，我幫您轉接。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello? Is anybody there? Her phone just rang and rang.
scene.zh: 喂？有人在嗎？她的電話一直響都沒人接。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would you like to hold or call back later?
scene.zh: 您要在線上稍等，還是晚點再打來？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'll call back later. Sorry to bother you.
scene.zh: 我晚點再打好了。不好意思打擾了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: What's her extension? I'll dial it myself at four o'clock.
scene.zh: 她的分機是幾號？我四點自己撥過去。

tasks.title: 她可能在開會
tasks.titleEn: She may be in a meeting

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good afternoon. I'd like to speak to Ms. Carter, please.
scene.zh: 午安。麻煩找 Carter 小姐。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: May I ask who's calling, please?
scene.zh: 請問您是哪一位？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: This is James Hughes, one of her clients in England.
scene.zh: 我是 James Hughes，她在英國的客戶。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'd like to talk to her personally, if I may.
scene.zh: 可以的話，我想跟她本人談。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: She might be in a meeting right now.
scene.zh: 她現在可能在開會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, she's been very busy lately.
scene.zh: 也是，她最近很忙。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: She typically calls me back the same day.
scene.zh: 她通常當天就會回我電話。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I'm afraid it's quite important. She can call me anytime today.
scene.zh: 這件事恐怕滿重要的。她今天隨時都可以打給我。

passages.title: Answering the telephone
lines: When Kate is away from the front desk, the telephone rings at every desk. Please answer it before it rings three times.
Say hello and the company name, and always ask for the caller's name.
If the person is out, take a message on his or her behalf. Write down the name, company and number accurately, and ask the reason for the call.
Never give a colleague's cellphone number to an unknown caller without permission.
If a call is urgent, let me know right away by text or by phone.

questions.en: What should you never give to an unknown caller?
questions.zh: 絕對不能給不認識的來電者什麼？

questions.en: What should you do when a call is urgent?
questions.zh: 遇到緊急的電話要怎麼做？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Did you read Ms. Carter's email about the telephone?
scene.zh: 你看了 Carter 小姐那封接電話的信嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: The big rule: never give her cellphone number to an unknown caller.
scene.zh: 最重要的一條：絕對不要把她的手機號碼給不認識的人。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: And if a call is urgent, tell her right away.
scene.zh: 還有，如果是緊急的電話，要馬上跟她說。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I text her or call her cellphone?
scene.zh: 我要傳訊息給她，還是打她的手機？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Text her first. She doesn't answer calls in meetings.
scene.zh: 先傳訊息。她開會的時候不接電話。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: If she doesn't text back in ten minutes, then call.
scene.zh: 如果她十分鐘內沒回，再打給她。

lines.en: Hello, this is James Hughes from Hughes Home and Garden, calling for Ms. Carter.
lines.zh: 您好，我是 Hughes Home and Garden 的 James Hughes，找 Carter 小姐。
是關於我十二月那筆訂單。

lines.en: I need to change the delivery date, and it's quite urgent.
lines.zh: 我需要改交貨日期，而且滿急的。

lines.en: Could she call me back today? I'm in the office until five o'clock.
lines.zh: 可以請她今天回電給我嗎？我五點以前都在辦公室。

questions.en: What does the caller want Ms. Carter to do?
questions.zh: 來電的人希望 Carter 小姐做什麼？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry to interrupt, but Mr. Hughes left a voicemail.
scene.zh: 不好意思打斷你一下，Mr. Hughes 留了語音留言。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. He rarely leaves messages, so it must be important.
scene.zh: 沒關係。他很少留言，一定是重要的事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Ms. Carter is out this morning. Can you summarize it for me?
scene.zh: Carter 小姐今天早上不在。你可以跟我講一下重點嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: He wants her to call him back sometime today.
scene.zh: 他希望她今天找個時間回電給他。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Let me hear it. Yes, that's his voice.
scene.zh: 我聽聽看。對，是他的聲音。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Pause it here and write down his number.
scene.zh: 在這裡按暫停，把他的號碼抄下來。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: She has his mobile number, too. In England, a cellphone is a mobile.
scene.zh: 她也有他的手機號碼。英國人把手機叫 mobile。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello, James Hughes again. Is Ms. Carter back yet?
scene.zh: 您好，又是我，James Hughes。Carter 小姐回來了嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: I only need to chat with her briefly.
scene.zh: 我只是想跟她簡單聊一下。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Would you like me to take a message?
scene.zh: 需要我幫您留言嗎？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Yes, please. Tell her I'd like to inquire about a new delivery date.
scene.zh: 好，麻煩你。跟她說我想問一下新的交貨日期。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: She can call me whenever she's free today.
scene.zh: 她今天有空的時候隨時都可以打給我。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll tell her as soon as she's back.
scene.zh: 她一回來我就馬上轉告她。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thank you. In the meantime, I'll send her an email.
scene.zh: 謝謝。這段時間我先寄封信給她。

lines.en: Thank you for calling Hughes Home and Garden. Our office is now closed.
lines.zh: 感謝您致電 Hughes Home and Garden。我們的辦公室現在已經下班了。

lines.en: We are open on weekdays from nine o'clock to five thirty.
lines.zh: 我們的上班時間是平日九點到五點半。

lines.en: If you know the extension, dial it now.
lines.zh: 如果您知道分機號碼，請現在撥。

lines.en: For the staff directory, press one. For inquiries about an order, press two.
lines.zh: 員工分機表請按一。訂單相關的詢問請按二。

lines.en: To speak to an operator, please call back during office hours.
lines.zh: 要找總機人員，請在上班時間再打來。

lines.en: To repeat this message, press three.
lines.zh: 要重聽這段訊息，請按三。

lines.en: After the tone, please leave your message, and we will call you back shortly.
lines.zh: 請在嗶聲後留言，我們會盡快回電給您。

questions.zh: 這間辦公室什麼時候有人上班？

questions.en: Which key should you press about an order?
questions.zh: 要問訂單的事，應該按哪個鍵？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: It's almost six in England, so they might be closed.
scene.zh: 英國那邊快六點了，他們可能下班了。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hear that? It's their voicemail. Leave a message after the tone.
scene.zh: 聽到了嗎？是語音信箱。嗶聲之後留言。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm calling from Harbor Trading about your December order.
scene.zh: 這裡是 Harbor Trading，打來是要跟您說十二月那筆訂單的事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Good. Now say your number twice, nice and slowly.
scene.zh: 很好。現在把你的電話號碼慢慢地講兩次。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Done? Then press one to send it.
scene.zh: 講完了嗎？那就按一送出。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: "Message sent successfully." Great. He'll probably call back shortly.
scene.zh: 「留言已成功送出。」很好。他大概很快就會回電。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello, it's James Hughes. I got your message.
scene.zh: 您好，我是 James Hughes。我聽到你的留言了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for getting back to me so quickly.
scene.zh: 謝謝您這麼快就回電給我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not at all. I'm on my commute, so it's loud.
scene.zh: 不客氣。我在下班回家的路上，所以有點吵。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Could we move the delivery to January the...?
scene.zh: 交貨可以改到一月……嗎？

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, you're breaking up a little.
scene.zh: 不好意思，您的聲音有點斷斷續續。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, bad signal. I can hardly hear you.
scene.zh: 抱歉，收訊不好。我幾乎聽不到你的聲音。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: January the fifteenth! And I'll be at the fair in June.
scene.zh: 我是說一月十五號！對了，六月的商展我會去。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hang on, I'm trying to concentrate on this email.
scene.zh: 等一下，我在專心寫這封信。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry to interrupt, but Mr. Hughes left a voicemail.
scene.zh: 不好意思打斷你一下，Mr. Hughes 留了語音留言。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: No problem. Ms. Carter went out, but she'll be back soon.
scene.zh: 沒關係。Carter 小姐出去了，不過很快就回來。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Should I text her or call her cellphone?
scene.zh: 我要傳訊息給她，還是打她的手機？

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Text her. Look, she already texted back. She wants you to call him.
scene.zh: 傳訊息吧。你看，她已經回了。她要你打給他。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hughes Home and Garden, James Hughes speaking.
scene.zh: Hughes Home and Garden，我是 James Hughes。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'm calling from Harbor Trading about your December order.
scene.zh: 這裡是 Harbor Trading，打來是要跟您說十二月那筆訂單的事。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thank you. I'd like the delivery on the... of January...
scene.zh: 謝謝。我希望交貨改到一月的……

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Sorry, you're breaking up a little.
scene.zh: 不好意思，您的聲音有點斷斷續續。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Sorry, it went silent for a moment. Let me call you right back.
scene.zh: 抱歉，剛剛突然沒聲音了。我馬上回撥給你。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: There's your phone. That's definitely him again.
scene.zh: 你的電話響了。一定又是他。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Hello, thank you for calling Harbor Trading.
scene.zh: Harbor Trading 您好，感謝您的來電。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello again, it's James Hughes. Sorry about the bad connection.
scene.zh: 又是我，James Hughes。抱歉，剛剛收訊太差了。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: Thanks for getting back to me so quickly.
scene.zh: 謝謝您這麼快就回電給我。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Not at all. Is Ms. Carter back? I'd like a word with her.
scene.zh: 不客氣。Carter 小姐回來了嗎？我想跟她說幾句。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: One moment, please, I'll transfer you.
scene.zh: 請稍等，我幫您轉接。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Hello? Her phone just rings. Nobody's answering.
scene.zh: 喂？她的電話一直響，沒有人接。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: She might be in a meeting right now.
scene.zh: 她現在可能在開會。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Then please tell her the fifteenth of January is fine.
scene.zh: 那請跟她說，一月十五號沒問題。

scene.speaker: player
scene.en: I'll tell her as soon as she's back.
scene.zh: 她一回來我就馬上轉告她。

scene.speaker: npc
scene.en: Thank you. If she has questions, don't hesitate to call me.
scene.zh: 謝謝。如果她有問題，儘管打給我。
